scope: Read-only saved release source and launcher review; no user data, logs, media, native execution, packet capture, production modifications, or OS network changes

critical_claims.claim: Initial gateways .1/.2/.3/.4, virtual IP .70, maximum 32 profiles
Physical Ethernet adapter and one matching LAN required; virtual IP belongs to same subnet and cannot equal a host address
Ethernet frame capture DLT_EN10MB required; macOS specifically checks IFM_ETHER; Wi-Fi not a supported configuration
Application private IPv4 stack, no OS route/address edits; IPv6-only sources and VPN-only transport unsupported
Windows native runtime is x64; Npcap driver is not bundled; DLL loaded from system Npcap directory
Npcap admin_only requires administrative capture access and may invoke its UAC helper
critical_claims.note: The application's own EXE does not bundle an elevation installer; do not tell users that non-elevated capture is guaranteed.

critical_claims.claim: Windows Java 17+ x64 required; private runtime, JAVA_EXE, JAVA_HOME or PATH are supported; no automatic Windows Java installer in launcher
critical_claims.note: Launcher checks java -version success, not the major number itself; class target/release requires Java17+. It also retains one developer-specific PyCharm fallback which root should omit from public packaging if changing launchers.

critical_claims.claim: Linux supports glibc x86_64/aarch64, normal user, sudo, desktop or --headless
Linux desktop uses X11 or Wayland with XWayland; checks X11/fontconfig runtime libraries
critical_claims.note: Launcher tests DISPLAY/WAYLAND_DISPLAY presence and libraries; it does not prove XWayland usability.

critical_claims.claim: Linux installs explicit package sets with apt-get/dnf/pacman only when prerequisites missing; no full distro upgrade
critical_claims.note: apt-get update refreshes indexes; pacman -S does not refresh Arch repository indexes. README advises normal distro maintenance.

critical_claims.claim: Linux native Java17+ architecture check, pinned verified private Temurin21 fallback, system Java retained
critical_claims.note: No external binary was downloaded or executed for this documentation audit.

critical_claims.claim: macOS installer accepts11+, Intelx86_64/AppleSiliconarm64; nativeJava17+; Rosettadetection. TorrentJNIrequiresnewerOS, detailed separately.
macOS missing AppleCLT prompts official installer, waits up to 30 minutes; no Homebrew/full Xcode requirement
critical_claims.note: Actual Apple SDK compilation and Finder flow remain unverified in the release.

critical_claims.claim: Deployment needs512MiB free on Linux/macOS; additional downloads space required
critical_claims.note: This is not a Windows enforced free-space preflight.

critical_claims.claim: No hard minimum RAM check or GPU/CUDA requirement;4GB RAM recommendation is guidance, not a measured minimum
critical_claims.note: Targeted source search found no memory sizing gate, Xmx setup, CUDA/GPU dependencies. 4GB is explicitly labeled a recommendation.

critical_claims.claim: POSIX helper alone receives sudo, opens capture, permanently drops supplementary groups/GID/UID; GUI remains normal user
Windows default data underlaunch/data; Linux/macOS per-user data/runtime/helper paths
critical_claims.note: --data-dir and saved data-location.config can override application data location.

critical_claims.claim: Default new-download destination user.home/Downloads
critical_claims.note: Saved desktop preferences can override it.

critical_claims.claim: Five UI languages, English default, Ctrl+V/nativeCmd+V paste
HTTP20MiB segments default,1..64MiB configuration;60sec no-data reclaim; torrentmetadata defines actual piece size
Speed test16MiB or5s transfer, preparation extra, not a download size limit
Torrent additional free-space guard uses3x neededpiecebytes same-volume/2x differentvolume plus16MiB allowance; destinationtotal plus16MiB
critical_claims.note: Conservative guard uses required piece bytes, including piece boundaries; it is not exactly three times selected file length in every torrent.

critical_claims.note: API.ru section10 further explains whole-file behavior; publisherchecksum absence is disclosed.

Local-onlyAPI127.0.0.1:8765/api/v1, JSONUTF8, POST/jobs explicitroutes, stableJSONlanguage-independent
